section: Iowa corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate on taxable income up to $100,000
note: Bracket: $0 to $100,000. Order 2025-02 keeps the 2024-2025 rates for tax years beginning in 2026 (receipts did not exceed the $700M trigger).
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Corporate Income Tax Rates

section: Iowa corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate on taxable income over $100,000
note: Bracket: taxable income over $100,000. Same rate for tax years beginning in 2024, 2025 and 2026.
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Corporate Income Tax Rates

section: Iowa corporate income and franchise taxes
label: 2026 corporate rates unchanged from 2024 and 2025
value: 5.5% up to $100,000 and 7.1% above, for tax years beginning in 2026
note: Iowa Department of Revenue Order 2025-02 certified the tax year 2026 rates.
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: IDR Issues Order Related to Tax Year 2026 Corporate Income Tax Rates (2025-10-21)

section: Iowa corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Franchise tax rate on financial institutions
note: Applies to banks, trust companies and savings and loans in 2026; scheduled to fall to 3.5% in 2027 and later.
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Tax/Fee Descriptions and Rates

label: Levied by
value: Counties, cities, school districts and special levying authorities (over 2,000 statewide)
note: Assessors set values; the county auditor sets levy rates from local budgets; the county treasurer collects.
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Tax/Fee Descriptions and Rates

label: State oversight
note: Supervises assessment, runs equalization every odd year and sets the annual assessment limitations.
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Property Tax Overview

label: Statewide limit on taxable value growth
value: Annual assessment limitation (rollback) set by the Department of Revenue for residential, agricultural and other classes
note: Taxable value = assessed value times the limitation percentage; the residential limitation for assessment year 2025 was 44.5345%.
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Property Tax Overview

label: Homestead exemption (from assessment year 2026)
value: 10% of the homestead's taxable value, minimum $5,500 and maximum $20,000 of taxable value
note: SF 2472 (2026) replaced the homestead credit (tax on $4,850 of value) with this exemption from assessment year 2026, i.e. taxes paid Sept 2027/March 2028. Age 65+ get a further $6,500.
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Homestead Tax Credit and Exemption

label: Real estate transfer tax rate
value: $0.80 per $500 of the total price, with the first $500 exempt
note: Each part-increment of $500 counts as a full increment. Paid to the county recorder when the deed is presented for recording.
source_title: Iowa Department of Revenue: Iowa Tax/Fee Descriptions and Rates
